components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Anuphan, 'Noto Sans Thai', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; background: transparent; color: #1c211b; border: 1px solid #b6beae; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #e3e7de; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c211b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: block; max-width: 320px; } .ds-label { display: block; font-family: Anuphan, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #535b4f; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; } .ds-money-field { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-money-field input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 64px; padding: 0.35rem 2.4rem 0.35rem 0.8rem; font-family: Trirong, Anuphan, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 2rem; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; color: #1c211b; background: #f8f9f5; border: 1px solid #b6beae; border-radius: 10px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-money-field input:focus { border-color: #1c211b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(31, 94, 61, 0.1); } .ds-unit { position: absolute; right: 0.85rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); font-family: Trirong, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #535b4f; }

components.name: Quick Chip
components.description: One-tap repeat entry in the dock.
components.css: .ds-quick-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 0.85rem 0 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #b6beae; background: #f8f9f5; color: #1c211b; font-family: Anuphan, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-quick-chip svg { color: #535b4f; } .ds-quick-chip:hover { border-color: #535b4f; background: #e3e7de; } .ds-quick-chip:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-quick-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c211b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-money { font-family: Trirong, Anuphan, serif; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-money-unit { font-size: 0.62em; margin-left: 0.18em; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Note Chips
components.description: Signature: today's allowance counted out as fanned banknote chips in fixed note inks.
components.html: 1001002020
components.css: .ds-notes { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 0 10px 4px; } .ds-note { --w: 64px; position: relative; width: var(--w); height: 34px; margin-left: calc(var(--w) * -0.5); border-radius: 4px; color: #fff; font-family: Trirong, Anuphan, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1; padding: 5px 7px; box-sizing: border-box; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.18), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); transform: rotate(var(--r, 0deg)); animation: ds-deal 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 55ms); } .ds-note:first-child { margin-left: 0; } .ds-note.gap { margin-left: calc(var(--w) * -0.12); } .ds-note::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-note::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 7px; top: 50%; width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-top: -7px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.34) 0 45%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 46% 100%); } .n20 { background: #2f7d4f; } .n100 { background: #b2303a; } @keyframes ds-deal { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-14px) rotate(-6deg); } }

components.css: .ds-meter-wrap { max-width: 360px; font-family: Anuphan, sans-serif; } .ds-meter { position: relative; height: 10px; margin: 0.85rem 0 0.5rem; border-radius: 3px; background: #e3e7de; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #d3d8cc; } .ds-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #2f7d4f; transition: width 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-pace { position: absolute; top: -4px; bottom: -4px; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: #1c211b; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-caption { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #535b4f; } .ds-ok { color: #2f7d4f; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
The app is printed, not rendered. A cool, faintly green fibre-paper ground carries every surface; the shell is a deep 20-baht green band engraved with faint guilloché linework; money is set in an engraved Thai serif with tabular figures, right-aligned in a single column. The five Thai banknote inks are the whole palette and each ink has exactly one job, so colour always carries meaning: green is the shell, the primary action and income; red is over-budget and destruction; gold is near-limit; blue and purple only appear in data and on denomination chips.

Structure comes from hairline rules on paper, not from cards. Sections are full-width panels divided by a 1px rule; lists are ledgers with day headers and rows separated by rules. The single piece of ornament with a job is the note chip: today's allowance is counted out as a small fanned stack of banknotes in their true inks. Dark mode is the same notes at night: an ink-green black ground with the inks lifted for legibility, while the note chips keep their printed colour.

Density is that of a working ledger: 15px body, 36px row tiles, 44px touch targets, one column on phones growing to a three-column ledger on wide desktops.
keyCharacteristics: Fibre-paper ground (light) / ink-green night ground (dark); never pure white or pure black.
Deep green header band with guilloché linework at 16–20% opacity.
Engraved serif money figures (Trirong 600, tabular lining numerals) with a reduced baht unit.
Hairline-ruled panels instead of cards; ledgers instead of tiles.
Banknote-ink semantics: one ink, one job.
Fanned denomination chips as the signature.
Authored line icons (lucide, 1.75 stroke), never emoji in chrome.

rules.name: The One Ink, One Job Rule
rules.body: Green = shell, primary action, income. Red = over budget and destructive. Gold = near limit. Blue and purple = data and denomination chips only. If a colour appears without its meaning, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Fixed Print Rule
rules.body: Note-chip inks (note-20/50/100/500/1000) are printed colours and do not change between themes.

rules.name: The No Pure Extremes Rule
rules.body: Grounds are paper (#eef0ea) or night green (#0e1411); text is ink, never #000 or #fff on paper.

rules.name: The Engraved Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount goes through the Money component: Trirong 600, lining tabular numerals, the baht sign at 0.62em weight 500, a true minus sign (−) and an explicit + on signed income. Money is never set in the UI sans, and only these four sizes exist.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Amounts are right-aligned in a single trailing column in every list, row and header.

rules.name: The Rules Not Cards Rule
rules.body: Content sections are separated by a 1px rule on paper. No stacked rounded cards, no shadow on panels.

dos: Do route every amount through Money (Trirong 600, tabular, ฿ at 0.62em, true minus) at one of the four fixed sizes.
Do keep amounts in one right-aligned trailing column.
Do separate sections with 1px hairline rules on paper.
Do give each ink its one job: green shell/action/income, red over/destructive, gold near-limit, blue and purple data and denomination chips only.
Do pair every status colour with an icon and text.
Do use lucide line icons at 1.75 stroke (2 for small status icons) in 36px tiles for categories.
Do define both themes for any new token; dark mode lifts text inks, keeps note inks fixed.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum (36px for small and secondary controls).
donts: Don't stack white rounded cards on grey or give panels shadows.
Don't use gradient balance cards or gradient surfaces; the only gradients are the note watermark disc and the loading shimmer.
Don't put emoji in chrome or category icons.
Don't show stock Bootstrap chrome (default blue, focus glow, default radii).
Don't use red, gold, blue or purple decoratively.
Don't set money in the UI sans, or invent new money sizes.
Don't add portraits, crests or seals to guilloché; it stays geometric linework.
